title: Ingabo Zahuye n'Ibumba Riguruka
intro: Mu gihe c’imbere y’Umuhanuzi Muhamadi, umutware w’inkomezi wo muri Yemeni yaratanguye igikorwa c’ingabo cari kigamije gusenya ahantu heranda h’i Makkah. Uwo mwansi yarongoye ingabo nini cane yuzuye inzovu z’intambara, yizigiye inkomezi zazo n’igitigiri cazo. Ariko rero, urugendo rwabo rwoheze bukwi na bukwi uko bahura n’Imana yari kubafasha batavyiteze. Woba ushobora kumenya abashikiwe n’ico giharuro kidasanzwe?
clues: Twaragendanye n’ingabo nyinshi cane be n’inzovu z’intambara zikomeye tuja ku nzu nyeranda .
Twari dufise umugambi wo kurandura no gusenyura ikibanza co gusengeramwo cubatswe n’abasuku b’Umunyakigongwe .
Haturungitswe umukumbi w’inyoni ntoyi, zitwaye amabuye y’ibumba mu minwa no mu maguru .
Twarahuye n’ijwi ryadutera amabuye, riduhindura amasigarira yahonyowe .
Nari uwo mu gihugu ca Yemeni kandi nakorera mu gihe c’umutware yarondera 挑衅 ahantu heranda .
Twaragizwe akarorero k'abashobora gutera ubwoba ngo desafío ahantu heranda ha Allah .
